timeline.summary: Vikran Engineering executed a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a 49% stake in NOPL Solar Projects for ₹4.90 crore.
Vikran Engineering completed the allotment of ₹50 Cr in secured, rated, unlisted NCDs across two tranches.
Vikran Engineering commissioned its second 5 MW solar power plant in Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra under the PM-KUSUM Scheme.
Vikran Engineering incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Vikran Renewable Private Limited, with a paid-up capital of ₹1 lakh.
Vikran Engineering incorporated VIKRAN For Good Foundation as a wholly owned Section 8 subsidiary on May 4, 2026.
Vikran Engineering disclosed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing full utilization of ₹721 Cr IPO proceeds.
Vikran Engineering completed the acquisition of a 49% stake in NOPL Solar Projects for ₹4.90 crore.
Vikran Engineering acquired the remaining 51% stake in NOPL Solar Projects for ₹5.10 crore, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
Vikran Engineering executed a Composite Amendment Agreement to close a ₹49.15 Cr loan given to Onix Renewable Limited.
Vikran Engineering Limited corrected its earnings conference call time from 03:30 PM IST to 10:00 AM IST on Tuesday, 26th May 2026, per Kajal Rakholiya, Thane.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹647.4 Cr, net profit ₹56 Cr.
Vikran Engineering published its Q4FY26 investor presentation reporting revenue of ₹647.4 Cr and an order book of ₹5,737 Cr.
Vikran Engineering reported record FY26 revenue of ₹1,249.31 Cr and an order book of ₹5,737 Cr, guiding for ₹2,200-2,500 Cr revenue in FY27.
Vikran Engineering allotted ₹10 Cr in secured, unlisted NCDs carrying an 11% coupon due June 2028.
Vikran Engineering allotted ₹25 Cr of secured, unrated, unlisted NCDs with an 11.40% coupon maturing in November 2027.
